ui.error.openpyxl:
The openpyxl library, used to write XLSX files, is missing.

Windows (OSGeo4W): run the OSGeo4W installer and add the python3-openpyxl package.
Linux: install the python3-openpyxl package.
macOS: in the QGIS Python console run: import pip; pip.main(['install', 'openpyxl'])

alg.name: Hand over data (XLSX)
alg.help:
Exports the layer to a formatted Excel workbook — the same file as the Data Handover window, without opening it. Use it in batch mode, in models and with qgis_process.

Columns, headers, units, descriptions, column order, personal data choices and the key column come from the layer settings saved in the project by the plugin window. The look, extra sheets, author and file language come from the window's saved settings; a colour preset or file language chosen here takes precedence.

To add the “Changes” sheet, give the previous file. The key column is used only together with the previous file; if left empty, the key saved in the window is used.
alg.error.no_fields: All columns of this layer are switched off in the plugin window. Tick at least one column there.
alg.error.no_selection: The layer has no selected features.

geo.desc.area.planar: Geometric area calculated on the plane of the layer's coordinate system ({crs}). This is not the official cadastral area and may differ from it.
geo.desc.length: Geometric length calculated on the {ellipsoid} ellipsoid from the layer geometry ({crs}).
geo.desc.length.planar: Geometric length calculated on the plane of the layer's coordinate system ({crs}).
geo.desc.x: X coordinate (easting, as in QGIS) of a point inside the feature, in the layer's coordinate system ({crs}).
geo.desc.y: Y coordinate (northing, as in QGIS) of a point inside the feature, in the layer's coordinate system ({crs}).
geo.desc.lat: Latitude of a point inside the feature, WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), decimal degrees.
geo.desc.lon: Longitude of a point inside the feature, WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), decimal degrees.
geo.desc.link: Opens {service} at a point inside the feature.
